terminology: OFF_LOCAL_CYCLE is a counterfactual component simulation. A model-filled alternative SELL E is a filled event under the original authenticated public execution model, as opposed to a censored simulation; it is not a new actual funded-account trade or published account execution.
output_contract: Keep origin_actual_* provenance separate from alternative_*_POSTHOC or explicit SIM fields. ON compares with the original actual funded account. OFF outcomes and local labels remain simulated/posthoc even when their model execution status is FILLED.
meaning_of_exact_control: ON exact reproduction verifies the local component's execution and state semantics on the original path; it does not convert OFF model fills into observed funded fills or prove a later state-conditioned whole policy.
reporting: 21 local component labels are not 21 new funded accounts. Do not call OFF returns realized account returns, sum them into account wealth, or present alternative model-filled trades as observed history.
